description: Defines interfaces and data structures for netlink communication in the quic namespace, including classes NetlinkParserInterface and NetlinkInterface, with methods for manipulating IP addresses, routing rules, and netlink messages.

classes.name: NetlinkInterface
classes.description: Interface providing methods for netlink operations such as getting link info, addresses, routing rules, and sending/receiving netlink messages.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Virtual method to process a netlink message.

methods.name: GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves link information for a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Modifies local IP addresses on a network interface.

methods.name: GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Gets routing rules from the main routing table.

methods.name: ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing rules.

methods.name: ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing policy rules.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a netlink message from the kernel.
